result: The Studio's PDF words state sizes through sizeWords: the text-layer bound reads 10 MiB and the page renderer and OCR bound reads 1 GiB, both from the contract limits.
acceptance: The text-layer sentence reads 'at most 10 MiB. OCR takes a PDF of up to 1 GiB' and the renderer sentence reads 'at most 400 pages and 1 GiB.'; neither rendered text contains '1024 MiB'
A PDF one byte above the bound reads 'This PDF is 1,07,37,41,825 bytes, above 1 GiB': a size that rounds to the bound's words is stated in bytes, so the line never reads '1 GiB, above 1 GiB'
A PDF of 1.5 times the bound reads 'This PDF is 1.5 GiB, above 1 GiB,'
sizeWords gives '1 GiB' for the 1 GiB bound and '17.3 MiB' for a 17.3 MiB file
decisions: sizeWords is imported from upload-model.ts unchanged; the local MiB helper in pdf-reading.ts is removed.
No contract, server, OpenAPI or pins edits.
